mlx-embeddings.note: GPL-3.0. Shipped unmodified, as the Python source files in engine/sp. It runs only inside the engine process, which Wisp reaches over a loopback HTTP connection.

pycountry.note: LGPL-2.1. Pure Python, shipped unmodified as readable source in engine/sp, so it can be replaced by another copy of the same package.

soxr.note: LGPL-2.1 or later. Compiled extension shipped unmodified; the source for this version is available from the project at the address listed with it.

cobble.note: BSD per its package metadata; the upstream wheel ships no licence file, so the notice names it and its project address instead.

flatbuffers.note: Apache-2.0 per its package metadata; the upstream wheel ships no licence file.

primp.note: MIT per its package metadata; the upstream wheel ships no licence file.

sentencepiece.note: Apache-2.0 per its package metadata; the upstream wheel ships no licence file.

tokenizers.note: Apache-2.0 per its package metadata; the upstream wheel ships no licence file.

vendored_javascript: The engine's admin dashboard (engine/omlx_web/static) ships third-party JavaScript libraries unmodified; each file keeps its own licence header.
